messages:
alex: FYI — MedBridge legal sent a short questionnaire and asked for: (1) a redacted ISO excerpt, (2) a signed pen-test attestation, and (3) confirmation on whether we will run a 6h weekend vuln scan (they prefer Sunday night). Need to coordinate ops + pricing. cc @rachel @tony

rachel: We can supply a redacted ISO snippet and SOC2 cover sheet. Pen-test attestation is our standard doc but legal sometimes asks for one-sentence rewording about scope. Security will need to sign.

tony: Ops: running the scan is doable on Sunday 02:00-08:00 UTC but requires the customer's firewall allowlist 24h prior. For Redwood-run scans we need temporary SSO access for the engineer and an ATO form completed. If the customer prefers to run it, we can provide target staging creds.

alex: Procurement asked whether scan facilitation is included or billed. They also want the attestation signed and returned within 48h.

billing-bot: PRICING_GUIDANCE: Standard POC includes artifact exchange only. Scan facilitation / live ops is billable. Suggested invoice item: "POC scan facilitation & ops (up to 6h)" = $1,050 one-time.

sec-bot: SECURITY: Pen-test attestation template stored at /compliance/templates/pen_test_attestation_standard.docx. For sign-off we need manager-level approval and no redlines preferred. If legal redlines scope, escalate to sec-legal; turnaround may extend by 2-3 business days. Also note: any network access requires signed NDA and ATO.

rachel: I'll upload a redacted ISO excerpt and generate a 48h presigned URL. Use presign command: aws s3 presign s3://proofpacks/medbridge/iso_redacted_v1.zip --expires-in 172800

tony: Hosted scanner IPs to allowlist: 35.199.11.10, 35.199.11.11. Bastion fingerprint available on request.

alex: Can billing add the $1,050 line to the quote and label it clearly? MedBridge procurement wants the fee explicit on the PO.

billing-bot: Done: added line item "POC scan facilitation & ops (up to 6h) — $1,050" to opportunity and attached billing note.

rachel: Uploaded redacted ISO and posted presign (placeholder): https://redwood-proofs.s3.amazonaws.com/medbridge/iso_redacted_presign?token=abc123

alex: Next steps we agreed: 1) rachel posts presign and pen-test template to CRM, 2) billing flags $1,050 on quote, 3) ton y confirm scanner IPs and bastion fingerprint if requested, 4) customer to complete ATO and NDA and confirm allowlist for 35.199.11.10/11 at least 24h ahead. I'll email procurement once presign is live.

tony: Confirming IPs: 35.199.11.10, 35.199.11.11. Bastion IP option: 35.199.11.12.

sec-bot: REMINDER: If legal requests wording changes to the attestation, tag #sec-legal and notify product counsel. Manager approval required for any changes.

alex: Thanks team — I'll handle the outreach to MedBridge and drop the ATO form in the doc share. :thumbsup:
